title: Allied agentic-AI CVE blocklist hardens into procurement gate by Q4 2026
body: By Q4 2026 the NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist published Saturday — naming Ni8mare (n8n CVE-2026-21858), LangGraph CVE-2026-44012, LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188, CrewAI CVE-2026-44352, and Haystack CVE-2026-44391 as disallowed pre-patch versions on NHS-tenant deployments — combined with Mistral's DGFiP central-tax-administration Workflows selection (cited control-plane separation + sovereign-cloud execution-worker shape over LangGraph self-hosted plus the Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 registry) and the South Korea PIPC + New Zealand GCSB weekend extensions of the Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter, will harden into a named-CVE-pegged sovereign-procurement gate adopted across at least four allied public-sector procurement regimes (UK NHS + France DGFiP + at least one Indo-Pacific signatory + one EU member-state framework agreement). The forcing function is that NHS England has now demonstrated a publishable per-CVE blocklist tied to a federal-civilian KEV-mirroring deadline (CISA May 21), Mistral has demonstrated that sovereign-cloud control-plane separation wins a flagship central-government estate against the LangGraph self-hosted alternative explicitly named on that blocklist, and the Indo-Pacific reciprocity perimeter now binds AISI-administered cyber-eval results as the operative threshold across the allied cohort. Once a UK frontline NHS trust + a French central-tax-administration estate publish concordant CVE-pegged tenancy terms and Anthropic's per-tenant attestation-log primitive (praised by Simon Willison Saturday as the first vendor-side governance shape that holds up to sustained audit-trail review) becomes the canonical compliance evidence, the gate composes from voluntary blocklist into procurement-mandate language. The most likely shape is a four-jurisdiction CVE-pegged annex (UK + France + Singapore-or-Japan + Germany-or-Netherlands BSI-equivalent) treating per-CVE remediation status plus per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation as paired procurement-eligibility evidence, with the operative review cadence aligned to the AISI cyber-eval reciprocity 120-day placement window. Bear case is that CISA fast-tracks an agentic-AI workflow KEV-bundle Binding Operational Directive that pre-empts the allied perimeter; absent that, Q4 2026 lands the named-CVE procurement gate.

reasoning.because: NHS England publishes named-CVE agentic-AI blocklist alongside DGFiP Mistral Workflows selection.
reasoning.given: Indo-Pacific reciprocity perimeter widens to South Korea PIPC and New Zealand GCSB the same weekend.
reasoning.so_that: Allied public-sector procurement adopts named-CVE-pegged tenancy plus per-tenant attestation as eligibility.
reasoning.landing: By Q4 2026; four jurisdictions; CISA KEV-mirroring cadence.
reasoning.plain_language: Britain's NHS banned five risky AI tools by name; France picked a sovereign one, and allies will copy that buying rule.

summary: NHS England's named-CVE agentic-AI blocklist plus Mistral's DGFiP central-tax-administration win, combined with the South Korea and New Zealand reciprocity-perimeter extensions, harden allied public-sector procurement around CVE-pegged tenancy and per-tenant attestation evidence by Q4 2026.
